settings._title: 03b · Sem critério (frase presa no scroll) · trilha do scroll

settings.html:
<style>
/* Cenas presas no scroll: trilha alta (.lp-track) + palco preso na tela (.lp-stage, sticky).
   O comprimento da trilha define quanto se rola com a cena parada. */
html, body { overflow-x: clip !important; }
#page, .site, .site-content, #content, .site-main, .elementor { overflow-x: clip !important; overflow-y: visible !important; }
.lp-track { position: relative; display: block !important; padding: 0 !important; min-height: 0 !important; overflow: visible !important; }
.lp-track--dor { height: 400vh; }
.lp-track--crit { height: 330vh; }
.lp-track--laptop { height: 260vh; }
.lp-stage { position: sticky !important; top: 0; height: 100vh; height: 100svh; }
.lp-stage--center { display: flex !important; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; }
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .lp-track--crit { height: 270vh; }
  .lp-track--laptop { height: 220vh; }
  /* Na cena do paciente, cena e card empilhados não cabem numa tela: sem palco preso, a cena
     avança enquanto a seção passa pela tela. */
  .lp-track--dor { height: auto; }
  .lp-track--dor > .lp-stage { position: relative !important; height: auto; }
}
/* Editor do Elementor e movimento reduzido: tudo no fluxo normal. */
.elementor-editor-active .lp-track, .lp-static .lp-track { height: auto !important; }
.elementor-editor-active .lp-stage, .lp-static .lp-stage { position: relative !important; height: auto; }
/* 03b · "Sem critério, a consulta vira improviso:" — painel turquesa que sobe com os cantos de cima
   chanfrados, trava na tela e monta a frase: as duas metades entram pelas laterais e "improviso:"
   vem gigante e desfocado até entrar em foco. Depois a seção segue o scroll normalmente. */
html, html.lenis { scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
html.lenis, html.lenis body { height: auto; }
.lenis.lenis-smooth [data-lenis-prevent] { overscroll-behavior: contain; }
.lenis.lenis-stopped { overflow: hidden; }

.lp-crit { --chamfer: 0px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate;
  clip-path: polygon(0 var(--chamfer), var(--chamfer) 0, calc(100% - var(--chamfer)) 0, 100% var(--chamfer), 100% 100%, 0 100%); }
.lp-crit-hex { position: absolute !important; inset: 0; width: 100% !important; height: 100%; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none;
  background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, .28) 1.4px, transparent 1.6px);
  background-size: 26px 26px;
  -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 45% at 50% 52%, #000 0%, transparent 75%);
  mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 45% at 50% 52%, #000 0%, transparent 75%); }
.lp-crit-content { position: relative; z-index: 2; }
.lp-crit-over .elementor-heading-title { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 18px; }
.lp-crit-over .elementor-heading-title::before, .lp-crit-over .elementor-heading-title::after { content: ""; width: 48px; height: 1px; background: currentColor; opacity: .7; }
.lp-crit-word .elementor-heading-title { display: block; text-align: center; transform-origin: 50% 55%; }
.lp-crit-line svg { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.lp-crit-line path { stroke-dasharray: 1; stroke-dashoffset: var(--draw, 0); }
.lp-crit-hint ul, .lp-crit-hint .elementor-icon-list-items { justify-content: center; }
.lp-crit-hint .elementor-icon-list-item { justify-content: center; }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .lp-crit { clip-path: none; } }
</style>
<script>
/* Motor das cenas presas no scroll (03 Dor, 03b Sem critério, notebook da 04). Vai repetido nos
   widgets que usam cenas, mas só a primeira cópia roda.

   Sem "pin" por JavaScript: cada cena fica num palco (.lp-stage) com position: sticky dentro de uma
   trilha alta (.lp-track). Quem segura o palco na tela é o próprio navegador, sem tremor e sem troca
   de camada. Este motor só mede quanto da trilha já foi rolado (0 → 1) e entrega esse progresso
   para cada cena, no mesmo quadro da rolagem. No desktop, a rolagem suave (Lenis) roda no mesmo laço. */
(function () {
  if (window.lpScroll) return;
  var CDN = {
    gsap: 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/gsap.min.js',
    lenis: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lenis@1.1.13/dist/lenis.min.js'
  };
  var scenes = [], started = false, needLayout = true, lastY = -1, lenis = null;
  var clamp = function (v) { return v < 0 ? 0 : v > 1 ? 1 : v; };
  var edit = function () {
    return document.body.classList.contains('elementor-editor-active') ||
      !!(window.elementorFrontend && elementorFrontend.isEditMode && elementorFrontend.isEditMode());
  };
  var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var desktop = window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches;

  function load(src) {
    return new Promise(function (ok) {
      var s = document.createElement('script');
      s.src = src; s.onload = ok; s.onerror = ok;
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    });
  }

  // Mede a posição das trilhas (só quando o layout muda; nunca a cada quadro).
  function layout() {
    needLayout = false;
    var y = window.scrollY, vh = window.innerHeight;
    scenes.forEach(function (s) {
      var r = s.track.getBoundingClientRect();
      s.top = r.top + y;
      s.height = r.height;
      s.stageH = s.stage.offsetHeight;
      s.sticky = getComputedStyle(s.stage).position === 'sticky' && s.height > s.stageH + 10;
      s.vh = vh;
    });
  }
  function frame() {
    if (needLayout) { layout(); lastY = -1; }
    var y = window.scrollY;
    if (y === lastY) return;
    lastY = y;
    scenes.forEach(function (s) {
      var p, enter = clamp((y + s.vh - s.top) / s.vh);
      if (s.sticky) p = clamp((y - s.top) / (s.height - s.stageH));
      else p = clamp((y + s.vh * 0.65 - s.top) / Math.max(1, s.height)); // celular sem palco preso
      if (p !== s.p || enter !== s.enter) { s.p = p; s.enter = enter; s.fn(p, enter); }
    });
  }
  function loop(t) {
    if (lenis) lenis.raf(t);
    frame();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  function smooth() {
    if (!window.Lenis || !desktop || reduce) return;
    lenis = new Lenis({ lerp: 0.1, smoothWheel: true });
    window.__lpLenis = lenis;
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var a = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a[href^="#"]');
      if (!a) return;
      var id = a.getAttribute('href');
      var target = id.length > 1 && document.querySelector(id);
      if (!target) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      lenis.scrollTo(target, { offset: -50 });
    }, true);
  }
  function start() {
    if (started) return;
    started = true;
    if (edit() || reduce) {
      document.documentElement.classList.add('lp-static');
      scenes.forEach(function (s) { if (s.done) s.done(); });
      return;
    }
    var p = Promise.resolve();
    if (!window.gsap) p = p.then(function () { return load(CDN.gsap); });
    if (desktop && !window.Lenis) p = p.then(function () { return load(CDN.lenis); });
    p.then(function () {
      scenes.forEach(function (s) { if (s.init) s.init(window.gsap); });
      smooth();
      var dirty = function () { needLayout = true; };
      window.addEventListener('resize', dirty);
      window.addEventListener('load', dirty);
      if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(dirty);
      if (window.ResizeObserver) new ResizeObserver(dirty).observe(document.body);
      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    });
  }

  window.lpScroll = {
    /* stage: o palco (.lp-stage) dentro da trilha (.lp-track).
       opts.init(gsap): prepara a cena; opts.update(p, enter): progresso da trilha (0–1) e da
       entrada da seção na tela (0–1); opts.done(): estado final (editor, movimento reduzido). */
    scene: function (stage, opts) {
      if (!stage) return;
      var track = stage.closest('.lp-track') || stage;
      scenes.push({ stage: stage, track: track, init: opts.init, fn: opts.update, done: opts.done, p: -1, enter: -1 });
      needLayout = true;
    },
    reduce: reduce
  };
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () { setTimeout(start, 0); });
  else setTimeout(start, 0);
})();
/* 03b · Sem critério: o palco fica preso na tela (sticky) e a frase se monta com o scroll.
   O motor (lp-boot.js) entrega o progresso; aqui só se aplica na linha do tempo (pausada). */
(function () {
  if (window.__lpCrit) return;
  window.__lpCrit = true;

  function scene(sec) {
    var $ = function (s) { return sec.querySelector(s); };
    var over = $('.lp-crit-over'), left = $('.lp-crit-left'), right = $('.lp-crit-right'), word = $('.lp-crit-word');
    var path = $('.lp-crit-line path'), hint = $('.lp-crit-hint'), hex = $('.lp-crit-hex');
    if (!word) return;
    var title = word.querySelector('.elementor-heading-title') || word;
    var tl = null, chamfer = 0;
    window.lpScroll.scene(sec, {
      init: function (gsap) {
        if (!gsap) return;
        var mobile = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 767px)').matches;
        chamfer = mobile ? 36 : 84;
        tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true, defaults: { ease: 'none' } });
        if (over) tl.fromTo(over, { autoAlpha: 0, y: 14 }, { autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.08 });
        tl.fromTo(left, { xPercent: -140, autoAlpha: 0 }, { xPercent: 0, autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.24, ease: 'power3.out' }, '>-0.02')
          .fromTo(right, { xPercent: 140, autoAlpha: 0 }, { xPercent: 0, autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.24, ease: 'power3.out' }, '<')
          .fromTo(title, { autoAlpha: 0 }, { autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.06 }, '<0.12')
          .fromTo(title, { scale: mobile ? 1.7 : 2.1, filter: 'blur(' + (mobile ? 16 : 26) + 'px)' },
                         { scale: 1, filter: 'blur(0px)', duration: 0.36, ease: 'power2.out' }, '<')
          .set(title, { filter: 'none' }); // sem filtro depois do foco: camada leve
        if (path) tl.fromTo(path, { '--draw': 1 }, { '--draw': 0, duration: 0.16 }, '>-0.04');
        if (hint) tl.fromTo(hint, { autoAlpha: 0, y: 10 }, { autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.07 }, '>-0.02');
        tl.to({}, { duration: 0.22 }); // segura a frase pronta antes de a seção seguir
        if (hex) tl.fromTo(hex, { y: 40 }, { y: -40, duration: tl.duration() }, 0);
        tl.progress(0);
      },
      update: function (p, enter) {
        // Cantos de cima chanfrados enquanto o painel sobe; abertos quando ele chega ao topo.
        sec.style.setProperty('--chamfer', (chamfer * (1 - enter)).toFixed(1) + 'px');
        if (tl) tl.progress(p);
      }
    });
  }

  function init() { Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.lp-crit'), scene); }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();
})();
</script>
